name: sims-house-3d
description: A Sims-style 3D house viewer built with Three.js - cutaway walls, furnished rooms and a full day/night cycle.

scripts.bake: npm run bake:static && npm run bake:dynamic
scripts.bake:static: npm run bake:export && npm run bake:blender -- --samples=32 --atlas=1024 --margin=4 && npm run bake:import
